== Name

code-typography - typography enabled in code

== Synopsis

*code-typography*

== Description

[subs="+replacements"]
----
C01 (C) (R) (TM) ... don't word--word -> <- => <=
----

[subs="+replacements"]
----
C02 \(C) \(R) \(TM) \... word\--word \-> \<- \=> \<=
C03 \*bold\* \_italic\_ \`code\` \#mark\# \^up\^ \~down\~
----

[subs="+replacements,+macros"]
----
C04 (C) pass:r[\(R)] pass:[(TM)] (R)
C05 pass:r[\*raw\* \->] pass:r[(C)] pass:[(C)]
C06 (C) anchor:code-target[]https://example.org/type[Next (R)] (TM)
C07 \*literal\* https://example.org/escape[\*label\* \^up\^ \__down__] (C)
C08 (C) xref:code-target[Target (R)] (TM)
C09 (C) ((Term (R))) (TM)
----

[subs="+attributes,+replacements,+macros"]
----
C10 (R) {prepared} (TM)
----

[subs="+quotes,+replacements"]
----
C11 *(C)* _(R)_ `(TM)`
C12 \*literal\* (C)
----

[subs="+quotes"]
----
C13 *(C)* \*literal\*
----

----
C14 (C) \*literal\* pass:r[(R)]
----

[literal,subs="+replacements"]
C15 (C) \(R) \*literal\* word--word

[literal,subs="+replacements,+macros"]
C16 (C) pass:r[\(R)] https://example.org/literal[Literal (TM)]

[source,rust,subs="+replacements"]
----
// C17 (C) "string" -> next <1>
// C18 \*literal\* (R) <2>
----
<1> First callout.
<2> Second callout.

[source,xml,subs="+replacements"]
----
<tag>C19 (C) & literal</tag> <!--1-->
----
<1> XML callout.

[subs="+replacements,+quotes,+macros"]
----
C20 *(C)*pass:r[\(R)]https://example.org/mixed[Next (TM)]...
C21 -- *middle* --
----

[subs="+replacements,+macros"]
----
C22 pass:[--] (C) pass:r[\...] (R)
C23 pass:r[(C)]anchor:after-raw[]https://example.org/after[After]
